title: Seahawks' schedule has them playing on every day of the week except Tuesday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Seahawks' schedule has them playing on every day of the week except Tuesday
sources.description: The NFL is increasingly moving games off Sundays to play them on other days of the week, when TV networks and streaming platforms will pay more money for them.
